items.problem: The validator surfaces a generic hint on build failure ('Common build errors after the namespace rewrite') that does not distinguish the project-name/WinRT-type-name collision, even though the raw CS0234 message literally names the project's own namespace — a machine-detectable signal.
items.evidence: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 lines 507-518: it prints distinct 'error CSxxxx' lines then a single generic pointer. The dev-agent hit CS0234 into namespace 'KeyCredentialManager' (session-log turns 39-50) and had to reason out the collision itself.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite' (the CS0104 / stale-bin-obj CS0234 subsections) and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 build-fail branch (~line 500-519).
items.proposed_improvement: In Validate-UwpMigration.ps1's build-fail branch, detect CS0234 errors whose namespace token equals the project base name ([IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($csproj)) and emit a targeted line pointing at the new namespace-collision pattern anchor, so the root cause is named rather than left to the agent to infer.
items.generalizes: The detection keys only on 'CS0234 namespace == project name', which is exactly the recurring collision signature for any API-named UWP sample — it will fire on every such scenario without being sample-specific.
